articles.title: Centre tells Supreme Court Nilekani-led panel formed to reform competitive exams
articles.summary: The Central government informed the Supreme Court about forming a high-level committee, chaired by Infosys co-founder Nandan Nilekani, to explore and recommend significant reforms. This initiative reflects the government's focus on modernizing governance and improving efficiency, likely through technological integration. This development is crucial for understanding India's administrative advancements and policy-making within the national framework.

articles.title: INTACH launches book documenting Mangalorean Catholic Heritage homes
articles.summary: INTACH (Indian National Trust for Art and Cultural Heritage) has launched a book meticulously documenting the unique heritage homes of the Mangalorean Catholic community. This initiative aims to preserve and highlight the distinctive architectural and cultural legacy of these historical residences, offering insights into their traditional designs and significance within India's rich heritage. The project underscores the importance of cultural preservation efforts.

articles.title: Shagufta Ali defends Sasural Simar Ka co-star Dipika Kakar's interfaith marriage to Shoaib Ibrahim; hits back at trolls over name change row
articles.summary: Actress Shagufta Ali has strongly defended her former co-star, Dipika Kakar, regarding her interfaith marriage to Shoaib Ibrahim. This incident brings to light broader social discussions in India concerning interfaith relationships and the challenges public figures face regarding personal freedom and religious harmony.
